task.instruction: Locate the most recent research paper about 'Algebraic Topology' under Mathematics published on ArXiv. Provide the title of the paper, the name of the authors, and the abstract.

final_answer:
The most recent paper in arXiv's Algebraic Topology (math.AT) listing is arXiv:2610.40639, submitted 29 October 2026 (appearing in the Friday, 30 October 2026 batch — the newest entry on the recent-submissions page).

**Title:** Multicomplexes in Action: Strong Formality of Compact Hyperkähler Manifolds

**Author:** Antonio Pio Contrò (sole author)

**Abstract:** We show that all compact hyperkähler manifolds are bigraded strongly formal in the sense of Milivojević and Stelzig, proving that in the context of pluripotential homotopy theory they play the same role as compact Kähler manifolds in rational homotopy theory. Indeed, the main result arises from general algebraic considerations on categories of objects with more differentials, that of multicomplexes and commutative n-differential graded algebras. For them we discuss a standard model category structure, introduce a generalization of the ∂∂̄-Lemma and establish an algebraic formality theorem.

**Additional details:** Subjects are Algebraic Topology (math.AT), primary, with Algebraic Geometry (math.AG) and Differential Geometry (math.DG) cross-listings. The paper is 27 KB in TeX source, carries the comment "Comments are welcome!", and has DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2610.40639.
